name: sdk
purpose: Official TypeScript SDK for the WAVE API — 34 API modules covering streaming, production, device management, analytics, content, and monetization behind a single `Wave` client.

capabilities.does: Live stream lifecycle, protocols, recordings, viewer metrics via `wave.pipeline`
Multi-camera production, scenes, transitions, graphics, audio mixing via `wave.studio`
Virtual Device Bridge (NDI/ONVIF/VISCA/Dante to USB UVC/UAC) via `wave.prism`
Desktop Node fleet management, health, commands via `wave.fleet`
Analytics, BI dashboards, revenue metrics via `wave.pulse`
Video clips, exports, AI highlights via `wave.clips`
Video editing, tracks, transitions, effects via `wave.editor`
Recording storage, VOD, archive policies via `wave.vault`

claims.text: The npm package is published as @wave-av/sdk
34 API modules covering streaming, production, device management, analytics, content, and monetization
A single `Wave` client class in src/index.ts composes every API module as a readonly property
Each API module is independently importable via a package.json subpath export (e.g. @wave-av/sdk/pipeline)
Takes zod ^3.22.0 as a peer dependency for runtime validation
